Total number of questions — 15

Performance of Pradhan Mantri Jan
Dhan Yojana
*16. SHRI DEREK O’ BRIEN: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the average size of loans sanctioned
under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
since its launch, the details thereof,
year-wise; and
(b) the total number of zero balance Jan
Dhan Yojana Accounts?
Loan Defaults in PSBs
*17. SHRI SANJAY SETH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has data on
people who have borrowed and defaulted
on a loan of more than 25 crores taken from
Public Sector Banks (PSBs);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the total NPAs with
PSBs as of December, 2018;
(d) whether Government envisages
stricter checks on loan advances of such
large amounts in the future; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Patients suffering from life-style
diseases
*18. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that cases of
diabetes and high blood pressure in the
country have grown up by more than
double in the last three years;
(b) if so, the data reported from different
sources; State-wise
(c) whether it is also a fact that people
diagnosed with common types of cancers
have grown up by 36 per cent in the last
one year period; and
(d) if so, the details of Government's
plans to support the patients through both
financial and medicinal procedures to stop
pre-mature deaths from cancer, diabetes,

7
cardio vascular diseases etc. in the
country?
Inclusion of petroleum products under
GST
*19. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that LPG,  kerosene,
naptha, furnace oil and tight diesel oil
attract GST but five other petroleum
products such as crude oil, high speed
diesel, motor spirit (petrol), natural gas and
aviation turbine fuel lie outside the tax
regime;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and by
when these products will come under GST;
and
(c) whether at any point of time, the
matter of inclusion of these petroleum
products has been discussed in the GST
council meetings, if so, the details thereof
and if not, the reasons therefor?
Rural and tribal areas covered under
SAUBHAGYA Scheme
*20. KUMARI SELJA: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is on track to
fulfil its promise to achieve universal
household electrification by 31st March,
2019;
(b) the number of families in rural and
tribal areas that have been provided
electricity till 31st December, 2018;
(c) the number of households which
have not yet been electrified in the State of
Haryana till 31st December, 2018; and
(d) the details of funds allocated and
released to each State under the
SAUBHAGYA  Scheme till 31st December,
2018?
Reversion from NPS to old pension
scheme
*21. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH VERMA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to refer to answer to Unstarred Question
2153 given in the Rajya Sabha on 1st
January, 2019 and state:
(a) the details of the authority to whom
officials of Central Government under NPS
need to represent for consideration of their
case to decide whether such delay is on
account of administrative delay or otherwise
as per the judgements of Hon'ble High Court
of Delhi;
(b) the basis on which Government or
the above authority would consider and
decide such cases in absence of any criteria
or guidelines;
(c) whether Government would revert
those Central Government employees
whose vacancies arose prior to 1st January,
2004 as per the orders of CA T, Ernakulam;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Complaints of misleading advertisements
over AYUSH and Herbal medicines
*22. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of complaints of
advertisements pertaining to AYUSH and
Herbal medicines received during the last
three years along with the names of such
companies;

8

(b) what actions Government has taken
against them; and
(c) whether it is a fact that a large number
of such companies are still functioning
despite action taken against them, if so,
Government's reaction in regard thereto?
Condition of Government hospitals in
Chhattisgarh

Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the condition of
Government hospitals in Chhattisgarh has
improved during the last three years, if so,
the details thereof;
(b) whether Government has taken
steps for modernisation/upgradation of
hospitals, especially hospitals

Total number of questions — 129
39
Medicinal plants in the country
154. SHRI TIRUCHI SIV A: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the medicinal plants
available in the country; and
(b) the details of the steps being taken
by Government for the farming,
conservation, processing and promotion of
such medicinal plants?
Promotion of ayurvedic system of
medicine
155. SHRI NARAYAN LAL
PANCHARIYA: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has taken any
steps to promote ayurvedic system of
medicine;
(b) if so, the details thereof, if not, the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has set up
ayurvedic clinics or started  ayurvedic
treatment at existing hospitals/clinics during
the last one year;
(d) if so, the details thereof, if not, the
reasons therefor; and
(e) the details regarding funds allocated
by Government for promotion of ayurvedic
system of medicine?
Patent for yoga mudras
156. SHRI P.L. PUNIA: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the origin of yoga as a
practice;
(b) whether Government has made
efforts to obtain patent of yoga mudras;

40
(c) if so, the reasons for the delay in
obtaining patent; and
(d) the further steps taken by
Government to acquire patent for yoga
mudras?
CSR complying companies
157. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL: Will the
Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has maintained
data regarding the Corporate Social
Responsibility (CSR)  compliance by
companies, if so, the details thereof since
2014 till date, State/UT/sector-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that many
companies are not complying under CSR,
if so, the details thereof and reasons therefor,
State/UT/sector-wise;
(c) the action taken by Government in
this regard and the result therefor; and
(d) whether Government has provided
schemes to the companies for CSR, if so,
the details thereof and the reasons therefor?
CSR spending in Jharkhand for
development
†158. SHRI SAMIR ORAON: Will the
Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of number of all
companies spending in CSR head during
last three years till date in the State of
Jharkhand and the total number and names
of those districts where the amount was
spent in CSR head, year-wise; and
(b) the details of total amount spent by
companies in CSR head dedicated for
employment and increasing income of local
communities and people affected by mining
project and for environment protection and
sustainable development in the State of
Jharkhand?
Mechanism of detect corporate frauds
159. SHRI NARAYAN LAL
PANCHARIYA: Will the Minister of
CORPORATE AFFAIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has put in
place any mechanism to detect corporate
frauds at nascent stage;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has assessed
the efficacy of existing fraud detection
mechanism in corporate world; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
CSR non-compliance
160. SHRI SANJAY SETH: Will the
Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has data on
CSR non-compliance by Indian companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken to ensure that CSR
funds are actually utilised judiciously; and
(d) the data on prosecutions undertaken
for non compliance with CSR guidelines?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

41
Growth of corporate sector
161. SHRI P.L. PUNIA: Will the
Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of growth made by the
Indian corporate sector during the last five
years;
(b) the details of employment created
in the country in the last five years by the
Indian corporate sector; and
(c) the steps taken by Government for
growth of corporate sector in the country?
Uneven flow of CSR funds to States
162. SHRI RAKESH SINHA: Will the
Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) to what extent PSUs have taken
measures to reorient policies and
implementation in line with the advice and
suggestions given by Hon'ble Prime
Minister during the address to CMDs and
Directors of PSUs in April, 2018;
(b) the steps being taken to arrest
uneven flow of CSR fund to different
States; and
(c) which States got less than 5% CSR
funds during Financial years 2015-16,
2016-17 and 2017-18?

Monuments Authority
